name: Kaseifu Onihei ~ Sennyuu! Miboujin Ikka Nyotai Mamire
original_name: 家政夫鬼平～潜入！未亡人一家女体まみれ
source:
Onihei is a housekeeper, employed mainly by a family without a man, who needs male help. At first sight, it looks like he works hard. But his secret purpose is to get their secrets, and make them his sex slaves....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090109030102/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006182]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
鬼平是一名家政夫，主要受雇于缺少男性、需要人手帮助的家庭。乍看之下，他工作非常勤恳，但其真正目的，是掌握她们的秘密，再将她们变成自己的性奴…
